name: Illinois

ties.applies_to: all kinds of office and measures
ties.note: The Illinois General Assembly's site did not give a readable page (a certificate failure), and no plain downloadable file of the Election Code was found on a state site. Nothing is recorded from any other publisher. See 'unread'.

unread.what: Illinois Election Code, 10 ILCS 5: the sections on tie votes and on recounts. Leads from the titles of search results, not read: 5/22-12 ('Declaration of winners for city or town offices - Tie votes'), 5/23-27 ('Finding of tie vote upon recount - Decision by lot'), and 5/22-3, 5/22-4, 5/7-59 and the Article 22 and 23 recount sections
unread.reason: 'NOT READ: curl failed for https://www.ilga.gov/legislation/ilcs/documents/001000050K22-3.htm: curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate'; the same message for the same path at https://ilga.gov/ (the host without 'www', the address that the search result itself gave). Certificate verification was not bypassed. No Illinois State Board of Elections guide that states the tie or recount rules was found: the 2025 Precinct Election Manual and the 2027 Candidate's Guide (both on elections.il.gov, read whole) contain no recount or tie text. Justia, the compilation the orchestrator allowed, refused us (HTTP 403 at its first request, for Georgia) and was not tried again; Cornell LII carries no Illinois statutes text.

notes: Illinois is unread. When a way to read the ILGA site (a working certificate chain) or another allowed publisher is available, the sections to read are the Election Code's Articles 7 (primaries), 22 (canvass, declaration of winners, discovery recount) and 23 (recount and tie), and 65 ILCS 5 (municipal code) for city offices.
